package com.x;
public class Stale {
  int step(long now, double suction, double lowLimit) { int t=4; if (suction<lowLimit) t--; return t; }
}
-- src/com/x/Clean.java --
package com.x;
public class Clean {
  int step(long now, int demandCount, double suction) { return demandCount <= 0 ? 0 : demandCount; }
}
